claims: Continue continuous ST-segment monitoring and cardiac telemetry for ongoing surveillance of blood pressure lability and cardiac risk.
Reassess and manage hypertension with the existing antihypertensive regimen, given multiple elevated systolic readings (up to 159 mmHg) and diastolic readings (up to 103 mmHg).
Monitor serum electrolytes and renal function, including sodium 148 mEq/L and anion gap 17 mEq/L, with repeat basic metabolic panel.
Continue pain management for moderate-to-severe pain (pain level 5-6) using the existing multimodal analgesic regimen.
Perform a fall-risk reassessment and implement fall precautions given bed rest, history of falls, and visual/hearing deficit.
Reposition and mobilize the patient as tolerated, with activity progression from bed mobility toward chair transfer.
Monitor blood glucose and continue glycemic management given fingerstick glucose 179 mg/dL and serum glucose 137 mg/dL.
Monitor oxygen saturation and respiratory status, with current SpO2 92-94% on room air and respiratory rate 21-22/min.
Continue stress ulcer prophylaxis and bowel regimen with the existing ordered agents.
Maintain and monitor vascular access and arterial line patency, including dressing integrity and zero/calibration checks.
